events.message: A 4-day Meghalaya loop for a solo, moderate-pace traveller: a day exploring Shillong and nearby Elephant Falls, a day based in Sohra covering the town, Mawsmai Caves and Nohkalikai Falls, a dedicated day for the Double Decker Living Root Bridge trek, and a final day visiting Mawlynnong village and the nearby Zingmaham root bridge. Mawsynram was left out to keep each day unhurried given no stated must-includes.

A 4-day moderate-pace loop from Shillong through Cherrapunji (Sohra) to Mawlynnong, mixing waterfalls, caves, village walks and root-bridge treks. Day 1 starts with Elephant Falls before opening hours allow Shillong's sightseeing; free afternoons on lighter days (Day 1, Day 4) leave room for a relaxed local lunch, market browsing or rest, and Day 3 is kept intentionally light on paper (only the Double Decker trek) because the Nongriat round trip is a strenuous 6-8 hour undertaking including rest time at the bottom, not a quick half-day stop.

destinations.name: Meghalaya
destinations.why_it_fits: Meghalaya suits a solo, moderate-pace traveller well: a compact loop through Shillong, Cherrapunji and Mawlynnong mixes easy village walks, cave visits and viewpoints with a couple of more active root-bridge treks, without requiring a packed schedule. No dietary, mobility, or must-include/avoid constraints were stated, so the mix favours the area's signature natural sights.

activities.name: Shillong city sightseeing
activities.notes: Meghalaya's capital; markets, lakes and colonial-era streets. Easy walking pace, good half-day base.

activities.name: Elephant Falls
activities.notes: Multi-tier waterfall just outside Shillong; short paved-step walk, quick add-on stop.

activities.name: Sohra (Cherrapunji) town and viewpoints
activities.notes: Base town for the falls and root-bridge area; good for orientation and a relaxed local lunch.

activities.name: Nohkalikai Falls viewpoint
activities.notes: One of India's tallest waterfalls; short walk to a viewing platform, best outside monsoon spray/mist extremes.

activities.name: Mawsmai Caves
activities.notes: Lit, walkable limestone cave near Sohra; easy short visit, low mobility demand for a cave.

activities.name: Double Decker Living Root Bridge trek
activities.notes: Signature Meghalaya trek to Nongriat via a long stepped descent/ascent; a full half-day, moderate exertion. A local guide is customary and effectively required.

activities.name: Mawlynnong village walk
activities.notes: Known as one of Asia's cleanest villages; flat, easy walking among bamboo-lined lanes.

activities.name: Zingmaham Living Root Bridge
activities.notes: Short root-bridge visit near Mawlynnong; pairs easily with the village walk on the same day.

activities.name: Mawsynram village and viewpoint
activities.notes: Famed as one of the wettest places on earth; visit for the scenery and viewpoint on a dry-season day, not for its rain.

soft_notes: Budget check is incomplete: lodging and/or flights cost is unknown, so the $43 shown excludes them. This cannot be verified as a pass.

Every single day ends by early-to-mid afternoon (12:37, 12:35, 13:30, 11:10) with no evening activity, dinner, or rest note on any of the four days — for a 'moderate pace' trip this reads as under-scheduled rather than moderate, especially Day 2 (done by 12:35) and Day 4 (done by 11:10).

Day 3 has an internal inconsistency: brief_summary describes the Nongriat/Double Decker round trip as a 'strenuous 6-8 hour undertaking including rest time at the bottom,' but the scheduled stop is only 300 minutes (8:30-13:30, 5 hours). If the real-world trek actually takes 6-8 hours, travellers may still be on the trail well past the itinerary's 13:30 end time, undermining the 'day kept light' framing.

The Double Decker Living Root Bridge trek (long stepped descent/ascent to Nongriat and back, guide 'effectively required') is a strenuous full-day undertaking that sits oddly against a stated 'moderate' pace with no mobility needs flagged — there's no easier alternative offered or explicit heads-up that this day is materially harder than the rest of the trip.

Days 2 and 4 leave the entire afternoon/evening completely blank (notes: null) despite brief_summary promising 'relaxed local lunch, market browsing or rest' on lighter days — that intent isn't reflected anywhere in the actual day data.
suggested_fixes: Reconcile Day 3's timing: extend the Double Decker stop to reflect the real 6-8 hour round trip (pushing end time to roughly 15:30-16:30) or correct the brief_summary's stated duration to match the scheduled 5 hours.
Add a concrete evening or late-afternoon suggestion (sunset viewpoint, local dinner spot, market) for Day 2 and Day 4 so the day doesn't just stop at midday with nothing planned.
Populate the 'notes' field for Day 1, Day 2, and Day 4 with the specific relaxed-afternoon suggestions (lunch spot, market, rest) referenced in brief_summary instead of leaving notes: null.

Flag the Double Decker/Nongriat trek explicitly as high-exertion relative to the traveller's 'moderate' pace preference, and offer a shorter root-bridge alternative (e.g., a nearer bridge without the full Nongriat descent) as an option.
